# Doral Freight Logistics, Inc.

> Licensed NVOCC and diversified transportation company established in 1999 in Doral (Miami), FL. One-stop shop for ocean freight, ground transportation, warehousing, customs brokerage and specialized cargo handling between Miami and the Caribbean, with focus on Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic.

## Core Services
- [Ocean Freight & NVOCC](https://doralfreight.com/#services): Licensed NVOCC operations, ocean freight consolidation/de-consolidation from Miami to the Caribbean since 1999.
- [Ground Transportation & Drayage](https://doralfreight.com/#services): LTL/FTL container loads, drayage, pickup & delivery on both ends of the route.
- [Warehousing & Distribution](https://doralfreight.com/#services): Warehouse in a secure industrial park with 24/7 surveillance camera system; segregation, distribution and in-bond storage in Puerto Rico.
- [Customs Brokerage & Documentation](https://doralfreight.com/#services): Customs freight broker, documentation and agency services keeping cargo moving through ports of entry.
- [Specialized Cargo](https://doralfreight.com/#services): Hazardous goods handling and over-dimensional freight shipping.

## Routes
- Miami (HQ) → San Juan, Puerto Rico
- Miami (HQ) → Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
- Miami (HQ) → Santiago, Dominican Republic

## FAQ
- Which routes do you specialize in? Miami to the Caribbean, focus on Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic, with own offices in Doral (HQ), Guaynabo, Santo Domingo and Santiago.
- What does "Licensed NVOCC" mean? Licensed to consolidate and ship ocean cargo under our own responsibility — one-stop shop for ocean freight.
- How is cargo protected? Warehouse in a secure industrial park with 24/7 surveillance camera system.
- Do you handle customs clearance? Yes: customs freight broker, documentation and agency services.
- What cargo types? LTL/FTL container loads, drayage, hazardous goods, over-dimensional freight.
- What is In-Bond Space? Bonded storage exclusive to Puerto Rico operations; cargo remains under customs control until released or forwarded.
